usageNotes: Reloads the network configuration on a PDM-managed node by applying any pending interface changes without a full reboot; requires ifupdown2 to be installed on the target node. Returns a UPID (async task identifier) — poll the task status to confirm the reload completed successfully. The caller must hold System.Modify on /system/network/interfaces.

examples.summary: Reload network config on node 'pdm1' after editing an interface

tips: ifupdown2 must be installed on the node; without it the call will fail with an error even though the API accepts the request.
The returned UPID can be polled via the tasks endpoint to verify the reload finished without errors before assuming connectivity is restored.
Briefly interrupts active network interfaces during the reload — avoid during maintenance windows that require uninterrupted connectivity.
Use 'localhost' as the node name only when the API call originates directly on that node.
